headline: Computational tools for isoform switching, regulatory modules, and sequencing cohort QC
label: Quantitative Omics Analysis Frameworks
summary: Long-read, single-cell, and large cohort sequencing datasets require analysis tools that yield quantitative, comparable outputs.
synthesis: The three preprints share an emphasis on standardized, reusable analysis infrastructure that converts sequencing-derived measurements into comparable quantitative outputs. IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR 2.0 is an R tool that improves isoform switch detection, adds functional annotations, and supports long-read and single-cell sequencing data. REMO provides a genome-wide set of DNA regulatory element modules as shared features for single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis. WxS-QC is an open-source Python/Hail pipeline for quality control of human whole-genome and whole-exome cohorts, refactored from gnomAD's QC code and released with an open test dataset. The common thread is shared, reusable infrastructure at the feature-definition or quality-control stage. What is new is the extension of this infrastructure to single-cell and long-read modalities in the first two items, and to cohort-scale QC in the third, rather than a shared data modality.
